ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2006, as amended); Criminal Law of the PRC (Articles 120-2, 191, 312 and 349); Foreign Investment Law of the PRC (2019) and its Implementation Regulations; Company Law of the PRC (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024); Administrative Measures for the Beneficial Owner Information jointly issued by PBOC and SAMR (Order No. 3, effective 1 November 2024); SAMR Provisions on the Administration of Enterprise Name Registration (2021); PBOC Administrative Measures for Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing of Financial Institutions (2021).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the foreign funding shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry, Companies House, Secretary of State, or equivalent competent registry in the foreign shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path for Apostille states: notarize the certificate copy before a local notary; obtain an Apostille from the designated competent authority; prepare a certified Simplified Chinese translation; do not add consular legalization. Consular Legalization path for non-member states: notarize the certificate copy; obtain authentication from the origin country's Ministry of Foreign Affairs or equivalent; obtain legalization from the PRC Embassy or Consulate; prepare a certified Simplified Chinese translation. The two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive; never chain them.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Active Status Certificate) of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Same competent registry authority that issued the Certificate of Incorporation of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Use either Hague Apostille path or Consular Legalization path as described above depending on the origin country's membership in the Hague Apostille Convention. The path must never combine an Apostille with consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney approving the WFOE formation, capital contribution, UBO disclosure, and authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the foreign shareholder, notarized by a local notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: For Hague Convention states: notarize the executed resolution or power of attorney; apply for an Apostille; translate into Simplified Chinese by a certified translator. For non-convention states: notarize; authenticate through the foreign ministry; legalize at the PRC Embassy/Consulate; translate. Parallel and mutually exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association of the WFOE in bilingual Simplified Chinese and English
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: All founding shareholders and PRC legal counsel; foreign shareholder signatures must be notarized and legalized or apostilled when executed outside China
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Foreign signatures follow the mutually exclusive Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization path based on the jurisdiction where the execution took place. The Chinese text must be reviewed for consistency with the Foreign Investment Law, Company Law and the approved business scope.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the foreign shareholder or investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The bank officer's signature must be notarized. For Apostille states, obtain an Apostille from the competent authority and then translate. For non-member states, obtain notarization, foreign ministry authentication, PRC consulate legalization, and then translate. Apostille and consular legalization are not sequential alternatives.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or Register of Directors and Shareholders of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registered agent or corporate secretary of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apply the same mutually exclusive authentication path: Hague Apostille if the issuance jurisdiction is an Apostille Contracting State; otherwise notarization, authentication, and PRC consular legalization. Then provide a certified Simplified Chinese translation.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before any incorporation step, the WFOE applicant, all UBOs with a 25% or greater direct or indirect interest, directors, supervisors, and authorized signatories must be screened against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, PRC domestic terrorist and money-laundering blacklists, SAMR dishonesty/disciplinary lists, and recognised international PEP databases. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for current and former politically exposed persons and their family members/close associates; the source of wealth and source of funds must be documented. For the custom keyboard cap manufacturing business, adverse-media and trade-sanctions screening must cover the final destination countries of export sales, customers, and counterparties. Any hit requires escalation to the AML compliance partner and, if confirmed, filing with the competent regulator under the AML Law. All screening records must be retained for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR National Enterprise Name Online Declaration System and National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (administered by the State Administration for Market Regulation and local Market Supervision Administration bureaus)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered Chinese name must follow the four-tier statutory convention: administrative division, distinctive trade name, industry or operating characteristics, and legal form

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 42, 43, 44, 46, 50, 57 and 70; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2020), Articles 12 through 18; Regulations on the Administration of Market Entity Registration (State Council Decree No. 746); Special Administrative Measures (Negative List) for Foreign Investment Access (2024 edition).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), acting through the local Municipal Administrative Bureau for Market Regulation at the registered office location, via the National Unified Enterprise Registration Online Service.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Market Entity Establishment Registration Application (Foreign-Invested Enterprise) together with the Articles of Association, filed through the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None under the current Company Law for an ordinary WFOE engaged in manufacturing; there is no statutory minimum paid-up capital and no blocked escrow account requirement. The shareholders must, however, specify the subscribed capital, the currency, and the payment schedule in the Articles of Association. Contributions must be made in full within the time limit set by the Articles, and capital contribution records must be truthful and registerable in the National Enterprise Credit Information System.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTIONS OF THE FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF THE WHOLLY FOREIGN-OWNED ENTERPRISE (LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY) KNOWN AS [COMPANY], CHINA. Pursuant to the Company Law of the People's Republic of China and the Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China, and in accordance with the Articles of Association, the First Meeting of the Board of Directors was duly convened on [date] at the Company's registered office. All directors were present and formed a lawful quorum. After due deliberation and by unanimous vote, the following resolutions were adopted: 1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION. The Board confirmed that the registered capital of the Company is [amount], subscribed by the sole shareholder [Foreign Parent]. The Board resolved that capital contributions may be made in cash or in lawful non-monetary property as stated in the Articles of Association, subject to any capital verification and foreign exchange filings required by applicable law. The Board delegated to the Legal Representative the authority to execute and submit the capital contribution schedule to the State Administration for Market Regulation and, if applicable, to the State Administration of Foreign Exchange. 2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION. The Board authorized the Legal Representative and the General Manager, jointly or singly in accordance with the banking mandate to be issued by the opening bank, to open RMB and foreign currency bank accounts in the name of the Company at a licensed commercial bank in China, to execute deposit and electronic banking agreements, and to operate such accounts exclusively for lawful corporate business. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION. The Board approved and adopted the registered office at [address] as the statutory domicile, service address, and place where the corporate seal, books, records, and statutory registers shall be kept. The Board instructed the General Manager to maintain custody of the business license, Articles of Association, board resolutions, and financial books at that address. 4. APPOINTMENT OF STATUTORY OFFICERS. The Board appointed [Name, nationality, passport number] as the Executive Director/Chairman, [Name] as General Manager, [Name] as Supervisor, and [Name] as Legal Representative. The Legal Representative is irrevocably authorized, for the purpose of Stage 2 formation, to file all registrations, open bank accounts, execute contracts, apply for licenses and permits, and represent the Company before all administrative authorities. 5. SEAL AND GOVERNANCE. The Board adopted a corporate seal management charter requiring separate custody of the company chop, financial seal, contract seal, and tax invoice seal. Any contract or payment instrument exceeding RMB [threshold] must bear the signature of the Legal Representative and be countersigned by the General Manager. 6. RATIFICATION. The Board ratified all acts performed prior to this meeting in connection with the incorporation of the Company and directed the officers to proceed with environmental filing, industrial licensing, fire safety application, and post-registration formalities. These resolutions are effective immediately and shall remain binding on the Company and its successors. Dated this [day] day of [month], [year]. [Signature], Secretary of the Board.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Business Scope Screening Against the Foreign Investment Negative List
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Unified Enterprise Registration Online Service, administered by the local Municipal Administrative Bureau for Market Regulation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the National Unified Enterprise Registration Online Service or appear in person at the competent local Municipal Administrative Bureau for Market Regulation window. File a name reservation for the proposed Chinese company name and the parallel English name, selecting the entity type as Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (limited liability). Clearly state the intended business scope as the manufacture of plastic keyboard keycaps, computer accessories, and related plastic injection molding products. Verify that the proposed scope is outside the Foreign Investment Negative List; if the activity is not restricted, proceed under the general registration procedure. Submit the proposed Articles of Association, the parent company certificate of incorporation, a board resolution authorizing the Chinese formation, and a notarized power of attorney appointing the formation agent. The authority will issue a Name Reservation Notice. If the name is rejected due to similarity or if the business scope falls within a negative list item, revise the name or restructure the equity and scope before resubmitting.
required_dossiers: Application form for enterprise name reservation
Proposed Articles of Association
Certificate of incorporation of the foreign parent company (notarized and legalized)
Board resolution of the parent authorizing WFOE formation
Power of attorney appointing the local formation agent
Identity documents or passport copies of directors and legal representative
Proposed business scope description and product line list
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name reservation is queried because of identical or confusingly similar registered names, submit a rectification covering letter and an alternate name list immediately. If the negative list is triggered, adjust the business scope or introduce a permitted domestic partner entity, then file a new reservation. Where the authority issues a formal refusal, apply for administrative reconsideration or correct the filed particulars and refile within the statutory correction period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental Impact Assessment Filing and Construction/Project Licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Bureau of Ecological Environment under the Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE), via the local online EIA filing platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before or concurrently with the municipal registration, submit the environmental classification self-check and the construction project Environmental Impact Registration Form through the local Ecological Environment Bureau online service. For a small-scale keyboard keycap injection molding facility using plastic pellets and non-hazardous pigments, characterize the operation as plastic product injection molding with no electroplating or coating unless otherwise determined by the competent authority. Provide a process description, material safety data sheets for all resins and additives, the factory lease or ownership certificate, and a layout of production and waste storage areas. If the Bureau classifies the project as requiring a formal EIA Report or Report Form, commission a licensed environmental assessment institution to prepare the required document within the extended SLA. Incorporate the EIA acceptance conditions into the building design, ventilation, waste segregation, and wastewater discharge plans.
required_dossiers: EIA registration form or qualified EIA report
Project description, process flow diagram, and production capacity statement
Raw material safety data sheets and resin composition declarations
Factory lease or title certificate and land-use certificate
Site plan, layout plan, and waste storage plan
Water supply and drainage connection certificates
Business license or name reservation notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the project is queried, file supplementary calculations and technical explanations within ten working days. If the project is upgraded to a higher EIA classification, cease physical construction until a full EIA Report has been prepared and approved by a licensed EIA institution. If the authority declines the filing due to incorrect category, resubmit under the correct category and pay any required environmental monitoring fees only if statutorily imposed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Incorporation Registration and Issuance of Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal Administrative Bureau for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Unified Enterprise Registration Online Service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the name reservation is obtained, submit the establishment registration application online by completing the standard market entity establishment form. Attach the notarized and legalized parent company incorporation documents, the Articles of Association, the pro-forma board resolution, appointment documents for the executive director, general manager, supervisor, and legal representative, identity documents, a proof of registered address, a lease contract, and, if already issued, the EIA filing receipt. Complete the beneficial ownership schedule for anti-money-laundering purposes and confirm that all beneficial owners are identified. No government registration fee is payable for the issuance of the business license. The authority will review the application, verify the identity of the legal representative, and issue the Unified Social Credit Code Business License for the legal-person enterprise. After issuance, the Company must register with the tax authority, open a bank account, and complete seal engraving before commencing operations.
required_dossiers: Completed market entity establishment registration application
Notarized and legalized certificate of incorporation of the foreign parent
Articles of Association signed by shareholders and directors
Parent board resolution approving the WFOE and capital contribution schedule
Bank references and capital contribution timeline
Power of attorney of the formation agent and legal representative
Original lease contract and proof of authorized registered office
Passport copies and appointment letters for directors, manager, supervisor, and legal representative
EIA filing receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registration authority issues a notice of correction, correct the particulars online or in writing within the statutory correction period. If the application is rejected for insufficient legalization of foreign documents, obtain apostille/consular legalization and resubmit. If the authority suspends processing due to negative list concerns, narrow the business scope and file a revised application. Final administrative refusals may be challenged through administrative reconsideration and, thereafter, administrative litigation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Banking, Tax, Customs, Civil Defense Fire Safety, and Occupational Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank, local tax bureau, customs authority, Fire and Rescue Section of the local Emergency Management Bureau, and the Municipal Bureau of Emergency Management
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Business License is issued, proceed immediately with post-registration operational licensing. Present the banking authorization resolution and license to a licensed commercial bank to open RMB and foreign-currency accounts. Complete tax registration and invoice quota application at the local tax authority. If the Company will import resins or export keycaps, complete customs registration and export-manufacturer filing. Apply for the engineering fire safety inspection with the Fire and Rescue Section by submitting the factory lease, fire-protection drawings, floor plan, and capacity statement. If the public security fire department inspects the premises, request issuance of the Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate or business occupancy fire certificate. Thereafter, register the occupational-disease-hazard project with the Municipal Bureau of Emergency Management and obtain workplace safety clearance through an on-site occupational health inspection.
required_dossiers: Business License with Unified Social Credit Code
Corporate seal and financial seal records
Board resolution authorizing bank account opening and bank signatories
Tax registration form and legal representative identity proof
Customs registration form and business scope description
Factory lease and lease registration certificate
Fire protection design drawings and fire safety system certifications
Structural load and equipment foundation approval
Occupational disease hazard registration and employee medical examination plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects account opening due to incomplete beneficial ownership forms, submit corrected forms and beneficial ownership declarations. If the tax authority queries bank account registration, provide the completed bank filing notice. If the fire inspection is suspended, implement fire-safety corrective works, submit a written rectification report, and request reinspection. If occupational clearance is delayed, appoint a licensed workplace safety agency to complete the hazard assessment and resubmit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Local Municipal Administrative Bureau for Market Regulation (SAMR) as the industrial licensing authority, with industry supervision by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) and customs registration for export manufacturing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business License for Enterprise as a Legal Person (Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise) with manufacturing scope; no separate special product license is required for keyboard keycap injection molding, but the factory must comply with general industrial product quality and export manufacturing registration requirements.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Municipal Bureau of Ecological Environment, operating under the Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Registration Form (filing) for small plastic injection molding facilities using non-toxic resins; if coating, painting, electroplating, or high-volume solvent use is added, or if the provincial classification threshold is exceeded, the project is upgraded to a formal EIA Report Form.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharged to municipal sewer must comply with COD not exceeding 300 mg/L, BOD not exceeding 150 mg/L, SS not exceeding 150 mg/L, pH 6-9, and applicable local sewer standards under GB 8978-1996. Volatile organic compounds and non-methane total hydrocarbons shall not exceed boundary concentration of 4.0 mg/m3 and organized exhaust concentration of 50 mg/m3 as required by GB 37822-2019. Hazardous waste such as waste oils, contaminated packaging, and used chemical containers must be classified, stored in an impermeable licensed area for no more than 90 days, and transferred to a qualified disposal entity using the standard hazardous waste transfer manifest.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Acceptance (Inspection) Certificate issued by the Fire and Rescue Section of the Emergency Management Bureau; structural load and floor-weight safety inspection for the injection molding machines; occupational-disease-hazard project registration with the Municipal Bureau of Emergency Management; workplace occupational health inspection; fire suppression, emergency exit, panic hardware, and ventilation system approval for enclosed production areas.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China, exercised through provincial and municipal tax service bureaus; the online taxpayer system is the STA's National Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax) portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A WFOE is a PRC domestic resident enterprise, not a non-resident entity. Upon incorporation, the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) issues a Business License containing the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which is legally the taxpayer identification number and VAT registration number. The SAMR issuance is automatically synchronized to the local STA tax service bureau under the integrated multi-certificate tax registration reform, so no separate TIN application is required. Within 30 days of the business license issuance, the WFOE must complete supplementary taxpayer records in the e-Tax portal, including legal representative, financial officer, accounting and bookkeeping standard, domestic bank settlement account, business scope, shareholder information and beneficial ownership declarations, and intended VAT taxpayer status. Before claiming export VAT zero-rating or refunds, the WFOE must also complete the export tax refund/exemption recordation in the e-Tax portal and nominate the bank account used for export refunds.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None for corporate income tax: the PRC does not provide a check-the-box pass-through election or hybrid mismatch elections. For VAT, a WFOE may voluntarily elect to be treated as a general VAT taxpayer even if its annual taxable sales are below the mandatory RMB 5 million threshold, a status that is required to claim export zero-rating and input VAT refunds.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: All PRC business entities must complete tax registration upon SAMR business license issuance; there is no economic turnover VAT-registration exemption threshold. The compulsory general VAT taxpayer registration threshold is annual taxable sales exceeding RMB 5,000,000, and manufacturers/exporters below the threshold may voluntarily register as general VAT taxpayers to obtain export refund capabilities.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: VAT invoices and special VAT invoices must be issued through the STA's full-digitalized electronic invoice service platform (e-invoice system) and are transmitted in real time to the Golden Tax Phase IV anti-fraud and risk-control environment. Each e-invoice is protected by anti-counterfeit encryption and a unique invoice identification code; no separate paper fiscal stamp is affixed. The e-invoice data is automatically cross-usable with customs declarations and foreign-exchange receipt records for export refund verification.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A general VAT taxpayer may claim the 0% VAT rate on physical exports of custom mechanical keyboard caps that are actually transported out of PRC customs territory, provided the goods have been declared to Customs through the China International Trade Single Window, the sale is made to an overseas customer, and the export proceeds are repatriated through SAFE-supervised bank channels. B2C online sales through Shopify Payments or Stripe are substantiated as exports only when each parcel or batch is cleared under an applicable customs export or cross-border e-commerce export supervision mode and the order, logistics, and payment records are preserved. The 0% rate eliminates output VAT and supports an input VAT refund; qualifying offshore digital services do not apply to this goods-based business.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bill of Entry) accepted through the China International Trade Single Window
Bill of Lading or air waybill issued by the carrying carrier evidencing physical departure from PRC customs territory
Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC), or the equivalent bank foreign-exchange receipt record and SAFE export-proceeds monitoring certificate
Cross-border e-commerce retail export order and logistics manifest when cleared under an e-commerce customs mode
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA, Customs, and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange match the export declaration code, VAT e-invoice data, logistics documents, and foreign-exchange receipt records through the Golden Tax Phase IV system. If export zero-rating cannot be substantiated, the STA will disallow the 0% rate and assess VAT at 13% on the export turnover, claw back any input VAT already refunded, charge a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% on the underpaid tax, and impose an administrative penalty of between 50% and five times the tax involved. Fraudulent export-refund claims involving forged customs documents, false bills of lading, fabricated FIRC records, or circular foreign-remittance arrangements are subject to criminal prosecution under PRC Criminal Law, including fines and imprisonment, with life imprisonment possible for especially large fraudulent export tax refund amounts.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC), with delegated foreign-exchange administration powers to the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMB is convertible for current-account transactions, including trade in goods and services, provided each payment and settlement is supported by genuine underlying transaction documentation such as contracts, invoices, customs declarations, and transport logs. Capital-account transactions, by contrast, remain heavily regulated and require explicit SAFE registration and approval before a domestic bank may execute the cross-border transfer. A Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) established in mainland China can receive inbound equity capital only through a dedicated foreign-exchange capital account after prior SAFE foreign-direct-investment (FDI) registration; the proceeds are subject to a negative list for business scope and cannot be freely converted into RMB for domestic loans, securities investment, or real estate speculation. Profit repatriation to offshore shareholders is lawful only after annual statutory audit and tax clearance, with the dividend remittance executed through a domestic bank using the approved current-account or capital-account purpose code. Prior approval is not generally required for dividends that satisfy all compliance conditions, but banks will apply their own reasonableness review. There is no blanket forced conversion of retained foreign-currency receipts; exporters may hold ongoing export proceeds in a foreign-currency current account or settle them into RMB at the bank's quoted exchange rate. However, all foreign-currency receipts must be repatriated into China through a licensed bank, and any conversion must be matched against customs data and trade contracts. This hybrid system of current-account convertibility and capital-account gatekeeping gives banks the central role in enforcing monetary policy, anti-money laundering rules, and balance-of-payments statistics.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: China does not presently mandate a fixed mandatory surrender ratio for export proceeds. The surviving statutory duty is repatriation: a WFOE manufacturing mechanical keyboard keycaps for export must bring all sales proceeds earned from foreign customers back into mainland China without unnecessary delay and bank them through an approved foreign-currency current-account settlement or a RMB settlement mechanism. In practice, banks monitor export receipts against customs declarations and logistics evidence, flagging overdue receipts or significant mismatches. Export proceeds can be retained in foreign currency or voluntarily sold for RMB at a domestic designated bank. Converted RMB proceeds are immediately available for local operating expenses such as factory rent, PBT plastic resin purchases, injection-moulding maintenance, and salaries, subject to standard trade background verification.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore fintech EMIs and digital-only cross-border banks are not viable as the primary treasury provider for a mainland China WFOE. Such entities generally do not hold a PBOC banking licence, cannot participate in the domestic CNAPS/CIPS clearing system, and are not permitted to open a compliant RMB settlement account for a Chinese legal entity. They may be used only as auxiliary collection or disbursement channels for e-commerce flows generated by Shopify and Stripe, provided they operate under a lawful cross-border payment service agreement with a licensed domestic institution. However, they cannot satisfy SAFE capital-account registration, import/export trade verification, or corporate statutory audit requirements, so all core treasury balances, tax payments, payroll, and FX settlements must remain in a domestic Tier-1 bank. Feasibility rating: Low as a replacement; Medium as an ancillary non-custodial connectivity layer.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For initial corporate account opening, the statutory legal representative, if a foreign national shareholder, is generally required to appear physically in the domestic bank branch or conduct a supervised video interview with a designated authorized manager physically present. Pure remote consular proxy opening without any face-to-face or video-verified authority is not acceptable for a WFOE capital account. Before signing account-opening documents, the bank will verify the legal representative's passport, the original notarized and Chinese-consulate-legalized incorporation certificate, the board resolution appointing directors, and the SAFE FDI registration certificate. If the legal representative cannot visit mainland China, the bank may accept an authorized Chinese manager with a notarized power of attorney, but the bank's compliance officer will require live identity verification and may still impose a post-opening due-diligence interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner is located outside China in a jurisdiction with opaque corporate substance or cannot demonstrate the economic origin of the accumulated wealth used to fund the WFOE.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized and consular-legalized overseas incorporation certificate, certificate of good standing for each intermediate entity, complete ownership chain map ending in natural-person UBOs, UBO and source-of-wealth declaration, personal tax residence certificate, and audited financial statements or bank reference letters from the principal bank of each contributing shareholder for the previous two years.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection arrives from a third-party or from a co-mingled corporate account rather than directly from the registered foreign shareholder, creating unexplained counterparty and source-of-funds risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Eleven to twelve months of original bank statements for the remitting account, a notarized shareholder loan or gift deed if the remittance is funded by a related party, a capital contribution schedule matching the SAFE-registered amount, and a detailed board resolution authorizing the exact wire, together with the bank's expected anti-money-laundering counterparty screening report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business profile of an ISIC 3240 keycap manufacturer appears inconsistent with revenue flows from Shopify and Stripe, inviting suspicion of invoice factoring, trade mis-invoicing, or hidden e-commerce intermediation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Factory lease and utility records, plastic resin purchase invoices, tooling/double-shot injection-moulding machine purchase or lease contracts, order-management system export logs, logistics waybills, Chinese customs export declarations (报关单), and a narrative of the payment chain showing why the WFOE uses Shopify/Stripe rather than direct letters of credit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Custom keycap designs may infringe third-party trademarks, anime franchises, or industrial-property rights, and the exported goods could violate foreign trade sanctions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written authorization or licensing letters from the relevant brand owners for any character-based keycaps, an intellectual-property compliance manual, end-user and anti-sanctions attestations from export customers, OFAC/EU/UN sanctions screening results, and a company policy prohibiting orders from embargoed jurisdictions or with replicative protected designs.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign shareholder shall remit equity capital via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 to the WFOE's specifically opened SAFE-registered FDI capital account at a domestic Tier-1 bank. The remittance instruction must include the WFOE's SAFE foreign-exchange registration number and the balance-of-payments transaction purpose code for inbound direct-investment equity capital. After funds are credited, the bank will require a capital verification report issued by a licensed Chinese accounting firm confirming that the contribution is released and available for stated operating purposes under the business-scope negative list. The WFOE must not mix personal funds, shareholder loans, or operational trade receipts into the capital account. All RMB conversion from that capital account must be handled by the domestic bank under SAFE monitoring and can be used only for the allowed production and operating expenses of the mechanical keyboard cap factory.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For raw-material imports, machine spare parts, and authorised vendor payments, the clearing rail will normally be a standard SWIFT MT103 current-account goods payment with an appropriate trade purpose code, supported by invoice, packing list, bill of lading or airway bill, and customs declaration. For larger or strategic purchases, an irrevocable commercial letter of credit (sight or usance) provides matching security, while documentary collections are acceptable where prior banking relationships and credit confidence exist. The WFOE's domestic bank will expect the beneficiary name, invoice currency, and goods description to agree exactly with the purchase contract and the customs record; any mismatch can trigger enhanced due diligence and delayed clearance. Payments for raw polymer pellets, colourants, keycap moulds, and accessories should be pre-noted in the bank's trade-finance system to avoid similarity with undisclosed service imports or royalty outflows.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore RMB forward settlement and sale contracts (远期结售汇) with domestic Tier-1 banks, valid only with genuine trade background and verified export or import contracts
Onshore cross-currency swaps and FX swaps used strictly to hedge the WFOE's working capital or trade-linked RMB/USD exposure
Plain-vanilla FX options with an underlying real trade transaction, approved by the domestic bank's derivatives desk

Offshore CNH non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) transacted by an overseas parent entity for balance-sheet hedging are permissible offshore but cannot be booked directly inside the mainland WFOE; onshore RMB NDFs are not permissible

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Enterprise Annual Information Publicity Report (Enterprise Annual Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Each calendar year from 1 January through 30 June, reporting on the preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing automatically results in inclusion on the SAMR Abnormal Operating List. If correction is not completed within three consecutive years, the WFOE is listed on the Serious Illegal and Untrustworthy Enterprise List, may face an administrative fine of RMB 5,000 to RMB 30,000, a three-year ban on the legal representative serving in any other enterprise, and administrative revocation or strike-off of the business license.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Settlement Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) through the local tax service authority and electronic tax filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 May of each year for the immediately preceding tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers an order to rectify, a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% on the unpaid tax, and fines of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 for ordinary non-filing. False or understated reporting is subject to penalties from 50% to 500% of the tax underpaid. Persistent non-compliance may lead to compulsory collection, asset preservation, tax credit blacklisting, and criminal referral.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) and State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the integrated national foreign investment information reporting system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Each calendar year from 1 January through 30 June, covering the prior year's foreign investor, ownership and operation information
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or false filing results in inclusion on the SAMR abnormal-operations list, a regulatory corrective notice, and administrative fines under the Foreign Investment Information Reporting Measures and Enterprise Information Publicity Regulations. Continued non-compliance may block cross-border corporate changes and capital-account processing and may be treated as a serious dishonest act.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) Equity Stock Annual Registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) through local SAFE branches or authorized banks using the ASOne and FDI registration systems
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 June of each year for the previous calendar year's FDI equity, ownership, loans, profits and dividend data
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Overdue or missing registration causes SAFE to mark the WFOE as abnormal or inactive, restricts foreign exchange settlement and payment in both current and capital accounts, and may trigger administrative fines under foreign exchange regulations. Repeated serious default may lead to suspension of cross-border payment and profit repatriation procedures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statutory Financial Statements Audit and Certified CPA Opinion
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: The WFOE's shareholders and board; the audited report must be retained and produced on demand to the SAFE, SAMR and tax authorities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The audit must be completed before the corporate income tax annual settlement deadline of 31 May; if the audited report must accompany the enterprise annual report, it must be finalized before the 30 June annual-report close
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Absence of a statutory audit renders the annual financial statements non-compliant for annual corporate tax settlement, foreign exchange stock registration, and SAMR informational inspections. The company may be compelled to rectify, named in an abnormal-operations list if selected for inspection, and denied certain tax carryforward benefits.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None by size threshold. Under Article 164 of the PRC Company Law, every limited-liability company, including a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise, must prepare annual financial statements and have them audited by a CPA firm lawfully established in the PRC. There is no legal exemption based on balance-sheet total, annual turnover, or headcount. Additional audit scrutiny arises when the WFOE is part of a listed group, has cross-border foreign exchange capital flows, or is selected by SAMR, STA, or SAFE for inspection, and no numerical threshold limits that obligation.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE); small enterprises meeting the PRC small-enterprise criteria may apply the Small Enterprise Accounting Standard (SEAS). The statutory audit is performed under the PRC Standards on Auditing issued by the Ministry of Finance. IFRS is not a statutory recognition framework in mainland China, but an overseas parent may require supplementary IFRS reconciliation for consolidation.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: There is no separate annual UBO confirmation form. Under the Beneficial Owner Information Management Measures (PBOC and SAMR, effective 1 November 2024), the WFOE must carry out an initial identification and filing of beneficial owners, submit a one-time catch-up filing before 31 May 2025 where incorporation predates the effective date, and file an updated UBO declaration within 30 calendar days of any shareholding transfer, control change, or beneficial-owner change. In parallel, any equity transfer must also be reported to SAMR as a change registration within 30 days of execution. Event-driven reporting is therefore the annual protocol, not a periodic filing.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of shareholders' meetings and board meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 - USD 2,500 per year for a registered address and corporate secretarial/agent support in major Chinese cities
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - USD 5,000 per year for a small or medium manufacturing WFOE with inventory, customs transactions, and cross-border parent reporting; more complex operations may exceed USD 5,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The standard Corporate Income Tax (CIT) rate is 25%; a certified High and New Technology Enterprise qualifies for a preferential 15% rate; a small low-profit enterprise with annual taxable income not exceeding RMB 3,000,000, employees no more than 300, and total assets no more than RMB 50,000,000 can enjoy a temporary effective rate of 5% during the 2023-2027 incentive window; eligible manufacturing WFOEs can claim a 100% super deduction for qualifying research and development expenditures and accelerated depreciation on injection-molding and automated keycap production equipment; tax losses may generally be carried forward for 5 years, with a 10-year carryforward available to qualifying high-technology and technology-advanced small and medium enterprises.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Resident Enterprise Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Form A100000; principal table with supporting schedules A105000, A105080, A107012 and related information schedules), filed through the State Taxation Administration e-Tax electronic filing service hall.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual settlement filing, with separate quarterly provisional CIT prepayments filed before the 15th day after each calendar quarter-end.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The final annual CIT return and settlement payment are due within 5 months after the fiscal year-end, i.e., no later than 31 May of the following calendar year for a 31 December balance-sheet date; quarterly prepayments are due within 15 days after the end of each of the first three quarters, and the annual settlement installment completes in the fifth month after year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating and principal-business revenue from the sale of custom mechanical keyboard keycaps, double-shot PBT injection products, novelty caps, and related processing income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report revenue on PRC GAAP accrual basis; reconcile Shopify, Stripe, and cross-border platform settlement records to export customs declaration amounts; intercompany sales to overseas affiliates must be supported by an arm's-length pricing policy, otherwise the tax authority may recharacterize and adjust the foreign-exchange-included revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating costs, including raw plastic pellets, PBT material, pigments, molds, direct labour, factory overheads, energy, and depreciation of injection equipment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain inventory sub-ledgers, import documentation, and production work orders; purchases from non-resident raw-material traders must satisfy the comparable uncontrolled price test; do not arbitrarily absorb management fees or central-charge allocations from the foreign parent into inventory cost without transfer-pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxes and surcharges other than CIT and VAT, including urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges, stamp duty, property tax, and land-use tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not deduct CIT, value-added tax, late-payment surcharges, fines, or non-resident dividend withholding tax; dividend withholding tax on distributions to foreign shareholders is not an expense of the WFOE and must be excluded from this box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling, administrative, and financial expenses, including direct sales commissions, e-commerce platform fees, freight, marketing, office costs, foreign exchange losses, and interest expense.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Entertainment expenses are deductible only up to 60% of actual spend and 0.5% of net revenue; advertising expenses are limited to 15% of net revenue; cross-border royalties, management fees, and interest paid to non-residents must satisfy arm's-length pricing, thin capitalization rules, withholding tax, and beneficial ownership conditions; any excess is book-tax difference to be added back in Schedule A105000.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating profit, calculated as Box 1 minus Box 2, Box 3, and Box 4.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the WFOE is a limited-function contract manufacturer in a global keyboard-cap group, its operating margin should correspond to a routine controlled-entity return under the transactional net margin method; a low or negative margin with high residual profit booked by a foreign affiliate triggers a special tax adjustment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-operating income and non-operating expenses, including government grants, fixed-asset disposal gains or losses, claims received from suppliers, and write-offs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recognize non-operating items on an accrual basis and attach documentary evidence; indemnity or compensation received from a foreign parent for defective products is taxable income if not clearly made as an equity capital contribution; policy-exempt income, if any, must be evidenced by a qualifying catalogue schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total profit before income tax, reconciling to the audited financial statements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any difference between statutory accounts and taxable income, such as non-deductible related-party provisions, fair-value changes, accelerated depreciation, tax-exempt government grants, or transfer-pricing adjustments, must be adjusted in Schedule A105000; net taxable loss carryforwards are applied after adjustments under the statutory limits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after tax adjustments and loss carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply losses within the 5-year general carryforward limit or the 10-year high-technology carryforward limit; do not deduct current-year losses attributable to an overseas affiliate's operation; transfer-pricing adjustments may eliminate artificial losses and reduce the available carryforward base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax rate and CIT payable, beginning with the 25% statutory rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: After applying the 25% statutory rate, subtract any preferential rate benefit (15% High and New Technology Enterprise or small low-profit effective 5% rate) and tax credits for quarterly prepayments; the resulting tax is a liability of the WFOE, not a deductible item in arriving at distributable profit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return triggers a fixed penalty of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000, and more than RMB 10,000 in serious circumstances; late payment bears daily interest surcharge of 0.05% of the overdue tax; understatement due to false schedules or concealed turnover attracts recovery of tax, interest, and a monetary penalty of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax; where intentional false invoicing, false declarations, or fraudulent improper deduction crosses the criminal threshold, responsible directors and finance officers face criminal liability under Criminal Law Article 201, with possible imprisonment up to seven years and fines.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Non-Resident Enterprise Income Tax Withholding Return (withholding declaration for China-source investment income, dividends, interest, royalties, and other income paid to a non-resident enterprise), filed electronically through the e-Tax non-resident module.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Event-driven; a separate withholding return is required for each payment or deemed payment to a non-resident beneficiary, including each dividend distribution declared and remitted by the WFOE to its foreign shareholder.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The withholding return and tax remittance are due within 7 days from the date of withholding, which occurs when the payment is made or, if earlier, when the amount becomes due; if a treaty-rate claim is made, the treaty benefit application and supporting tax residency certificates must accompany the withholding declaration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross payment amount, type of China-source income, statutory withholding rate, claimed treaty rate, tax base, tax withheld, and bank remittance slip details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Withhold at the statutory 10% rate unless the non-resident beneficiary has provided a valid Tax Residency Certificate and beneficial-ownership file before the remittance date; the payer must not reduce withholding to a treaty rate merely because the shareholder is registered in a treaty jurisdiction; if the treaty-rate claim is rejected, the shortfall is payable with interest and penalty risk.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to withhold or remit non-resident income tax makes the WFOE and its responsible persons jointly answerable for the uncollected tax and statutory interest; penalties under the Tax Collection and Administration Law apply, and a knowingly false treaty-rate filing can be prosecuted as tax evasion; the legal representative may also be placed on the serious-tax-violation blacklist and be subject to a China exit travel ban.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on the gross amount of dividends paid by the resident WFOE to a non-resident enterprise shareholder; the rate may be reduced under an applicable Double Tax Agreement, for example to 5% under the Mainland-PRC/Hong Kong arrangement when the beneficial owner holds at least 25% of the paid-up capital and satisfies material substance conditions, but 10% remains the statutory default when no treaty relief is claimed or substantiated.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief, the non-resident shareholder must (i) obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the competent authority of its residence jurisdiction for the income year; (ii) deliver the TRC, certificate of incorporation, current shareholding registry, board resolution on the distribution, and a beneficial-ownership declaration to the WFOE before payment; (iii) demonstrate real economic substance in the residence jurisdiction, including an office, staff, decision-making authority, risk-bearing, and the absence of a conduit or pass-through arrangement; (iv) enable the WFOE to file the non-resident withholding return and treaty-rate schedule in the e-Tax system; and (v) if the tax authority denies the reduced rate, pay the statutory 10% withholding and later pursue a refund claim through the treaty application procedure within the statutory limitation period.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: The statutory withholding tax on cross-border interest and royalty income derived by a non-resident enterprise is 10% each; applicable DTA rates commonly range from 5% to 10% for royalties and 5% to 10% for interest, depending on the residence jurisdiction and the nature of the intellectual property or debt; interest paid on excessive related-party borrowings may be recharacterized as a dividend under thin capitalization and denied treaty benefits, while royalty payments for brand names or technical know-how paid to shell entities without economic substance will be denied DTA relief under the beneficial-ownership and principal-purpose tests.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Under SAT Public Announcement 2016 No. 42, a Local File is mandatory when annual related-party transactions exceed RMB 200,000,000 for tangible goods such as injection-molded keycaps, RMB 100,000,000 for intangible property transfers or licensing, RMB 100,000,000 for financial asset transfers, or RMB 40,000,000 for any other related-party transactions; a Master File and Country-by-Country Report may additionally be required when the consolidated group revenue of the ultimate parent reaches RMB 5,500,000,000.
